strings.отец Пешка Анфилофова сына Лодыгина: father of Peshok Anfilofov syn Lodygin
strings.Рязанская земля; Ярославский, Кашинский,: The Ryazan land; Yaroslavl, Kashin, Uglich, Tver and Oryol uyezds; the Russian North and the Northern Dvina
strings.деревня Красникова, Жабенский стан Кашин: village of Krasnikova, Zhabensky stan of Kashin uyezd
strings.Не назван самостоятельным участником акт: Not named as an independent participant in the act: his personal name and paternity are reconstructed from the formula «Пешок Анфилофов сын Лодыгина» ["Peshok, Anfilof's son, Lodygin"] of about 1499–1505.
strings.Пешок трижды прослеживается в кашинском: Peshok can be traced three times in the Kashin circle of acts: around 1499–1505 he was a witness (poslukh) to a deed of purchase for the village of Krasnikovo, around 1505–1510 he wrote in his own hand a deed of purchase for the village of Novosyolki, and in 1515/1516 he is again recorded as a witness in Kalyazin Book IV.
strings.Обе полностью опубликованные сделки отно: Both fully published transactions belong to the Zhabensky stan of Kashin uyezd and to the same circle of owners — Istoma Timofeyevich Kharlanov, Zakhary Ignatyev and his sons. They do not mention Nikolskoye Svechino, the Yurlovs, Onfilogovo or its neighbouring villages.
strings.Анфилоф, вероятно, принадлежал к поколен: Anfilof probably belonged to the generation of the middle or second half of the 15th century. The Kashin trace makes him a regional candidate, but so far it documents only the existence of a father with the right name, not his landholding or resettlement to Khorvach volost.
strings.Пояснение, прежде стоявшее в имени карто: Note formerly included in the card's name: "father of Peshok".
strings.Форма «Пешок Анфилофов сын» является пря: The form «Пешок Анфилофов сын» ["Peshok, Anfilof's son"] is a direct patronymic and attests a father named Anfilof, even if he was not present at the transaction.
strings.Надёжно восстанавливаются имя и отцовств: The name and paternity are reliably reconstructed. That the father himself belonged to the Lodygins is probable from the son's full designation, but the source gives no separate family designation for the father.
strings.Пешок был совершеннолетним около 1499—15: Peshok was of age around 1499–1505; the father belongs to an earlier, probably 15th-century generation.
strings.Почему отец получил отдельный профиль: Why the father received a separate profile
strings.Редкое имя отца — самостоятельный предме: The father's rare name is a subject of research in its own right. The patronymic attests the person reliably enough not to hide him within his son's biography, but the profile is marked as reconstructed rather than as a directly named participant in the act.
strings.Что известно через сына: What is known through the son
strings.Пешок был послухом и собственноручно при: Peshok was a witness and set his own hand to the deed of purchase; later he appears in other Kashin land acts. The repetition rules out an accidental misreading of his full designation.
strings.Кашинский уезд принадлежит тверскому ист: Kashin uyezd belongs to the Tver historical and geographical sphere but remains a landholding complex separate from Tver uyezd.
strings.Лодыгин — имя рода, а не доказанное проз: Lodygin is a family name, not a proven byname of the father
strings.Полная формула сына позволяет осторожно: The son's full formula allows the father to be cautiously assigned to the Lodygin family, but the source contains no separate line «Анфилоф Лодыгин» ["Anfilof Lodygin"]. The profile's title is therefore convenient for searching, and the degree of reconstruction is stated explicitly.
strings.Нет акта с Никольским Свечином, Онфилого: There is no act involving Nikolskoye Svechino, Onfilogovo, the Yurlovs or a resettlement of the family from Kashin.
strings.Особенно ценны были бы ранние кашинско-т: Especially valuable would be early Kashin and Tver acts of the Lodygins, service by members of the family to the Yurlovs, a landholding near Nikolskoye Svechino, or the transfer of Anfilof's household between uyezds.
strings.До 1600 года имя Анфилоф/Анфилог, близки: Before 1600 the name Anfilof/Anfilog, the close forms Anfil/Onfil and derived patronymics are documented in at least seven regional settings. The northern series now includes the Anfilovskaya village of 1573 and the sheepskin-maker Anfilofy Novik Ivanov syn of 1575; the Vladimir muster roll (desyatnya) of 1596 shows on the primary scan the exact formula «Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Anfilov son of Vakin"]. This makes the model of several independent family formations more probable than the search for one common incoming founder, but the towns of origin of the seven Oryol lines have not yet been established.
strings.ИМЕНА И МЕХАНИЗМ. Реестр показывает две:
NAMES AND MECHANISM. The register shows two different stages. In the first, Anfilof, Anfilog or the close documentary forms Anfil and Onfil are the personal name of a specific man: Anfilof Selivanov, Anfilofy Ivanovich, Anfilof Moiseyevich, Anfilog Ivanovich Konstantinov, Onfilof Nesterov, Onfil Ivanov, Anfil Vakin of Vladimir and Anpilog Ivanovich Onanyin. In the second, the name becomes a dependent naming of another person: Antipa Anfilogov syn, Peshok Anfilofov syn, Tonkoi Onfilogov and Antip Anfilov syn Vakina. Hence the -ov form existed as a patronymic or family naming long before it can confidently be regarded as a hereditary surname.

THE 16TH-CENTURY INTERVAL. The Kurostrov scrolls give a dense cross-section: in 1549 Onfilof Nesterov pays together with his nephew, in the 1550s he is probably repeated as «Анфилофей Несте…» ["Anfilofey Neste…"], and in 1592 Onfil Ivanov is recorded separately. In 1596 the Vladimir muster roll adds the formula «Антип Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Antip Anfilov son of Vakin"], which on the primary scan clearly separates the patronymic Anfilov and the third naming Vakin. Nearby occur Petrok Anfilov and a long line of Anfal / Anfalov. They are kept for comparison but not mixed into the main series: A. F. Bek's reference book lists Anfalov from Aifal/Anfal separately from Anfilov from Amfilokhy or Anfim.

GEOGRAPHY. The bearers do not form a single linear path. They appear simultaneously in the Ryazan land, Yaroslavl, Kashin, Vladimir, the Russian North, the Northern Dvina and Uglich. This distribution is too wide for the assumption of one common recent ancestor. Ryazan stands out for the repetition of the name in different generations and for its proximity to the documented resettlement of servicemen to the new southern towns; the Kashin–Uglich circle for its proximity to the Tver Onfilogovo; Vladimir for a formula contemporary with Oryol but independent. None of them has yet been connected to Oryol by a personal move.

MEANING FOR THE ORYOL CORE. In Oryol in 1594/95 there already existed at least seven fathers of surname bearers: Mikula, Vasily, Persha, Timofey, Nechay, Pakhom and Terenty. At the same time, in another Oryol nest, a pomeshchik with the personal name Anpilog Onanyin is known. The most economical new model is not to look for one ready-made family that suddenly arrived in Oryol, but to examine several families in which the name Anfilog could independently have turned into a patronymic and then into a stable family naming.
strings.Найти служебные продолжения рязанских но: Find service continuations of the Ryazan bearers of the name between the 1530s and the founding of Oryol.
strings.Вернуться к Лодыгиным только при появлен: Return to the Lodygins only if a patronymic, inherited land or a direct formula of transfer between the Kashin circle and southern service appears.
strings.Искать семерых орловских отцов по полным: Search for the seven Oryol fathers by full formulas and former pomestyes, without assuming a common surname in advance.
strings.Заказать однолистные акты Архива СПбИИ Р: Order the single-sheet acts of the Archive of the St Petersburg Institute of History of the Russian Academy of Sciences (SPbII РАН), f. 5, op. 1, d. 554 and 567: check the boundaries of the Anfilovskaya village and the full formulary of Anfilofy Novik's deed of purchase.
strings.Не объединять региональные случаи без пр: Do not merge regional cases without a direct kinship or migration formula.
strings.Около 1499—1505 годов Пешок Анфилофов сы: Around 1499–1505 Peshok Anfilofov syn Lodygin attested a Kashin deed of purchase; his patronymic documents a father, Anfilof, of the previous generation.
strings.Пешок Лодыгин был послухом и собственнор: Peshok Lodygin was a witness and attested the deed of purchase in his own hand. The formula Anfilofov syn directly preserves the name of his father Anfilof, although the father is not named as a separate party to the transaction. Later acts show Peshok as a scribe and witness until 1515/1516. The Kashin geography makes the father an important regional candidate for research, but no act connects him with Nikolskoye Svechino.
strings.Не найден отдельный акт, где отец Анфило: No separate act has been found in which the father, Anfilof, is named in person.
strings.Не установлена связь Лодыгиных с Никольс: A connection of the Lodygins with Nikolskoye Svechino has not been established.
